equipment.name: Helium ion microscope
equipment.specifications: Allows structuring nanoscale materials on a lengthscale of sub-10 nm or even down to the single defect level

equipment.name: Focused ion beam
equipment.specifications: Utilizes Ga+-ions to locally sputter materials such as metals into nanoscale circuits and fabricate thin lamellas

equipment.name: Atomic layer deposition system
equipment.specifications: Thin-film deposition technique based on the sequential use of a gas phase chemical process

equipment.name: Atomic force microscope
equipment.specifications: Allows characterizing the surface of nanoscale materials with a resolution close to the atomic limit

equipment.name: XPS/UPS system
equipment.specifications: Relies on the photoemission of electrons from thin surface layers and allow characterizing their elemental composition
